title: Infernal Alloy
summary: Give Infernal Alloy to Dammon at Last Light Inn for the Flawed Helldusk set.

fields.Crafting: Use the Grymforge metal dialogue three times to receive Flawed Helldusk Armour, Helmet, and Gloves. This preserves Infernal Iron for Karlach.
fields.Acquisition: Kith rewards the alloy for passing his History, Investigation, and Perception checks. It can also be purchased from him or looted.
fields.Base value: 100 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
